name: aggregate_nested_mixed_semantics
rule:
  aggregate:
    - condition: "cond1"
      rule:
        match:
          - condition: "cond2"
            rule:
              aggregate:
                - condition: "true"
                  output: "'nested'"

name: "aggregate_nested_mixed_semantics"
description: "Tests that nested aggregate rules under an aggregate ancestor rule raise a compilation error"
sections:
- name: "compile"
  tests:
  - name: "nested_aggregate_error"
    output:
      error_set:
      - "nested aggregate rules are not allowed"
